entities.summary: Nils Arvid Ramm was a Swedish heavyweight boxer who won a silver medal at the 1928 Summer Olympics. Previously he won the 1927 European title and finished second in 1925. After the Olympics Ramm turned professional and had a record of 17 wins, 4 losses and one draw before retiring in 1931.
